targets.query:
from(bucket: "network_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "network_traffic" and r["_field"] == "count")
  |> sum()
  |> yield(name: "total_packets")

from(bucket: "network_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "network_traffic" and r["_field"] == "bytes")
  |> sum()
  |> yield(name: "total_bytes")

from(bucket: "network_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "ids_alerts" and r["_field"] == "count")
  |> sum()
  |> yield(name: "total_alerts")

from(bucket: "network_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "network_traffic" and r["_field"] == "bytes")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "protocol_bytes")

from(bucket: "network_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "network_traffic" and r["_field"] == "count")
  |> group(columns: ["protocol"])
  |> sum()
  |> yield(name: "proto_counts")

from(bucket: "network_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "network_traffic" and r["_field"] == "bytes")
  |> group(columns: ["src_ip"])
  |> sum()
  |> top(n: 10, columns: ["_value"])
  |> yield(name: "top_talkers")

from(bucket: "network_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "dns_activity" and r["_field"] == "count")
  |> group(columns: ["client_ip", "query_name"])
  |> sum()
  |> top(n: 20, columns: ["_value"])
  |> yield(name: "dns_queries")

panels.title: 🚨 Real-Time Intrusion Detection System (IDS) Alert Log

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "ids_alerts")
  |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 50)
  |> yield(name: "alerts_table")
